<function name="GetLayerSequence" parent="Entity" type="classfunc">
	<description>
Returns the sequence id of given layer.

<note>This function only works on <page>BaseAnimatingOverlay</page> entities.</note>
	</description>
	<added>2020.06.24</added>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="layerID" type="number">The Layer ID.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">The sequenceID of the layer.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
